constraint_parameters: i=seed-430000; a=2+i%8; b=3+i//8; c=6+i; target_a=2*c-2; target_b=2*c
goal_protocol: Fixed eleven-candidate three-register bundle; three complete endpoint goals; change only goal; unique P/Q/R winners require all three operations. Eight distinct two-set distractors cover every single-goal-atom omission; set costs1 in this arm

atom_ablation_protocol: For each of 224 prototype tasks, drop each goal atom separately and dual-check a changed nonempty optimum; 288 goal-arm and 256 constraint-arm ablations. These 544 diagnostic executions are included in the 800-task cap
ablation_ties: X without constraints, drop goal a: exact tie between overshoot-prefix F and multiply-copy R prefix, both cost2. Preserve complete best sets in all diagnostic executions
conjunction_reservation: maximum_value(a) AND protected_register(c); DEV prototype only; no production TRAIN/OOD claim or sealed instrument change
candidate_identity_protocol: SHA256(seed,arm,index) opaque IDs and independent parent-hash order fixed across every sibling; no gold-derived rotation
baseline_protocol: One current v2 DEV H register row at same seed, selected from an audited v2 group; positive valid singleton add heuristic; cross-version contrast is descriptive because goal and candidate construction differ
interpretation: Mechanical DEV construction and exact custody diagnostics; no learned performance, generic compositional generalization, global action-space optimality, new canonical profile, training, or publication
